Description: tokener 0.1.0 - Claude Code to Amazon Bedrock token-optimisation gateway (ECS Fargate, ALB, DynamoDB, CloudWatch). AWS Marketplace container product.

ContainerImage.Description: Container image URI (AWS Marketplace ECR). Leave the default unless support tells you otherwise.

MarketplaceProductCode.Description: AWS Marketplace product code for usage registration. Pre-filled by the listing; leave empty only for BYOL / evaluation builds.

CertificateArn.ConstraintDescription: must be an ACM certificate ARN in this region
CertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate ARN for the gateway hostname. HTTPS is mandatory: developer tokens travel in this connection.

DomainName.Description: Hostname developers will use (e.g. claude-gw.example.com). Create a DNS CNAME to the LoadBalancerDns output after deployment.

AdminAllowedCidrs.ConstraintDescription: comma-separated IPv4 CIDRs, or empty to disable the admin UI
AdminAllowedCidrs.Description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to reach the admin UI and API (/admin). Empty disables /admin at the load balancer (returns 403).

AlertEmail.Description: Optional e-mail for CloudWatch alarms (spend, errors, unhealthy tasks). You will receive an SNS confirmation.

DesiredCount.Description: Number of gateway tasks. 2 gives zero-downtime deploys; 1 is enough for evaluation.

NatGateways.Description: NAT gateways for the private subnets. 1 is cheaper; 2 survives an AZ outage.

UpstreamMode.Description: Bedrock API used by default: mantle (Anthropic Messages API on Bedrock) or runtime (classic InvokeModel). Changeable later in the admin UI.

BedrockProfilePrefix.Description: Inference-profile prefix for runtime mode. Pick the one matching your region's cross-region profiles.

TeamDailyAlertUsd.Description: Alarm when the team's estimated daily Bedrock spend (USD) crosses this value.

ExistingTaskRoleArn.Description: Optional: ARN of an IAM role you manage for the gateway tasks. Empty = the stack creates a least-privilege role. See the documentation for the required permissions.

PermissionsBoundaryArn.Description: Optional: permissions boundary policy ARN applied to every IAM role this stack creates.

Properties.Description: tokener admin UI bearer token (generated at deploy time)
tokener gateway task role: Bedrock inference, model catalog, usage tables, Marketplace metering
tokener task execution role: pull the Marketplace image, write logs, read the admin token

Properties.GroupDescription: Automatically created Security Group for ELB tokenermarketplaceServiceLBCC216427

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: Allow all outbound traffic by default

FixedResponseConfig.MessageBody: {"error":"admin UI is restricted to the AdminAllowedCidrs of this deployment"}

Properties.AlarmDescription: More than 20 failed model requests in 5 minutes
Estimated team spend for the day crossed the alert threshold
A gateway task is failing its health check
A gateway task exited because AWS Marketplace usage registration failed (subscription or IAM problem)

AdminTokenSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager secret holding the admin token
